تقتحمون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَحِمُونَ (taqtaḥimūna) /taq.ta.ħi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# تُقْتَحَمُونَ (tuqtaḥamūna) /tuq.ta.ħa.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
